+title: Remove the temporary `.open` default of the mode of compose and RoutedACPAgent
+---
+## What
+Commit abb9643 (2026-11-10) added a temporary default `mode: ToolMode = .open` to `ComposedAgent.compose` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/ComposedAgent.swift` ~199) and `RoutedACPAgent.init` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/RoutedACPAgent.swift` ~481). testudoapp-75 asked for it, because the required mode broke each clean build of TestudoApp (AppAgent compose) and of the FoundationModelsACPClient integration tests (`IntegrationTests/LiveAgentServer`).
+
+External dependencies (not on this board): TestudoApp ^3czzrg4 gives the mode, and FoundationModelsACPClient gives `mode: .open`. Do not start until testudoapp-75 confirms that both are pushed.
+
+1. Remove `= .open` from both signatures.
+2. Change the two doc comments back: the mode has no default value, so a host must select one.
+3. Confirm that each caller in this package gives `mode:` (Sources, Tests, IntegrationTests).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `compose` and `RoutedACPAgent.init` have no default value for `mode`.
+- [ ] This package and its IntegrationTests build.
+- [ ] The commit is sent to testudoapp-75.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `swift build`, `swift build --build-tests --package-path IntegrationTests` and `swift test` pass with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
